info.name: Error based SQL Injection
author: pdteam
info.description: A database error message in the response shows that user input reaches the SQL query unsanitized.
info.remediation: Use parameterized queries and never build SQL from request data.

extracted-results: You have an error in your SQL syntax

info.name: Git Configuration - Detect
author: pdteam
info.description: The .git/config file is publicly reachable and may disclose repository URLs and embedded credentials.
info.remediation: Deny access to /.git on the web server and keep the directory out of the deployment artifact.

info.name: Apache 2.4.49 - Path Traversal
author: pdteam
info.description: A path normalization flaw in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 lets an attacker read files outside the document root.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later.

info.name: HTTP Missing Security Headers
author: pdteam
info.description: The response lacks a recommended security header.
